Yes, both are right. Typing " DESIGN " with the capitals and extra spaces didn't sprout a second pill — it recognized it as the "design" I already had, so no near-duplicate crept in from spacing or capitalization, and it let me know it's already on there. That's exactly the kind of thing I was worried about when I asked for suggestions earlier: I don't want "design," "Design," and " design " all piling up as if they were different. And a totally empty label being refused — the Add button just staying inactive until I've actually typed something — is sensible too; a blank tag would be meaningless.

So the label tidying-up handles the messy-input cases the way I'd want. Happy with this.
